text_block_list.name: Hishi Ama & Biko
text_block_list.text:
"—Bonjour! Welcome to your French birthday 
dinner, Lady Laurel."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, bonjour! Thank you for the 
invitation. I wonder what I'll be treated 
to♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I put my whole heart into making this—the 
'Spring Carrot Arc de Triomphe Salad'!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"'Go, go, go, go, go☆Carrotman! So sweet, 
so sweet! Spring carrots are great for 
salads~♪'"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...So, see! I made carrot rapées to give 
it a French twist!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Looks delicious! Ah, I see, prepared like 
a French salad—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, that's not all, you know. The 
artichoke aspic resembles turf. And at the 
very top...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Ama & Biko
text_block_list.text:
—An Arc de Triomphe pie! —Arc de Triomphe 
pie!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fully packed with nutrients, Laurel-senpai 
is powered up! Making a b-line straight 
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...!\nI get to take a bite out of the 
Arc de Triomphe!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I made a whole bunch for ya. Eat 
until your belly's completely full!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then—Pour vingt personnes. Twenty 
portions, please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! That's Laurel for you! I'm itching 
for a good challenge!
